questions.question: The ratio between the nominal and real GDP is called ____.
Which of the following identity is correct regarding GNP?
questions.option_1: GNP = GDP – Factor income earned by the domestic factors of production employed in the rest of the world – Factor income earned by the factors of production of the rest of the world employed in the domestic economy
questions.option_2: GNP = GDP + Factor income earned by the domestic factors of production employed in the rest of the world – Factor income earned by the factors of production of the rest of the world employed in the domestic economy
